assets.name: Game Animation Sample
assets.source: Epic Games Launcher: Unreal Engine > Samples > Game Animation Sample > Create Project
assets.licence: Epic sample content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.installedTo: game/Content/ (Audio, Blueprints, Characters, Input, IsolatedExamples, Levels, MetaHumans, Misc, Movies, Widgets), with game/Config/*.ini and its plugins in Rim3D.uproject
assets.usedFor: character locomotion (motion matching) and the Stage 0 character test
assets.reinstall: Create the sample at C:\Dev\GameAnimationSample, then copy its Content folder over game/Content

assets.name: ImGui (Unreal plugin by VesCodes, bundling Dear ImGui 1.92.8)
assets.installedTo: game/Plugins/ImGui/ (not in Git); enabled in game/Rim3D.uproject, used by the Rim3D module (Rim3D.Build.cs)
assets.usedFor: the overseer's inspect panel and speed controls (U6), later the architect menu and colony panels (U7, U8)
assets.reinstall: git clone https://github.com/VesCodes/ImGui.git game/Plugins/ImGui, then git -C game/Plugins/ImGui checkout 71f29cf675b7d501af4f8e152fb73145f24a3f58

assets.name: Pawn looks (generated)
assets.source: Made by the PawnLooks commandlet from the Game Animation Sample's Kellan and the MetaHuman body type DNA files in the engine's MetaHumanCharacter plugin
assets.licence: Derived from Epic sample content and engine content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.usedFor: body shape morphs on Kellan's body and clothes, our skin material, horns (docs/design/looks.md)

assets.name: Building ghost material (generated)
assets.source: Made by the BuildingMaterials commandlet: our own unlit translucent material with a Color and an Opacity, marked for instanced static meshes
assets.usedFor: blueprints and the whole-building ghost behind frames (docs/design/building-draw.md)

assets.name: Wound decal material (generated)
assets.source: Made by the FightMaterials commandlet: our own deferred decal with a Color and an Opacity that blends a round soft-edged blob into what it lands on
assets.usedFor: wounds on bodies and blood on the ground (docs/design/fights.md)

assets.name: Placeholder art (Poly Haven)
assets.source: https://polyhaven.com, models listed in assets/placeholder_art.json, 1k glTF downloaded by tools/placeholder_art.py
assets.installedTo: files in game/Content/ThirdParty/PlaceholderArt/ and the made meshes and materials in game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Art/ (neither in Git)
assets.usedFor: placeholder meshes for the bed, door, tables, stool, stove, logs, meals, berries, trees and bushes (docs/design/building-draw.md)

assets.name: Terrain textures (Poly Haven)
assets.source: https://polyhaven.com (and https://ambientcg.com if a layer says so), layers listed in assets/terrain_textures.json, 1k JPG colour and DirectX normal maps downloaded by tools/terrain_textures.py
assets.installedTo: files in game/Content/ThirdParty/TerrainTextures/ and the made textures and material (M_Terrain, MI_Terrain) in game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Terrain/ (neither in Git)
assets.usedFor: the ground, sand, gravel and rock of the runtime terrain (docs/design/terrain.md); Megascans can replace them by setting a layer to "local" in the list

assets.name: Animal art (Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animals)
assets.source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html (public Google Drive folder), FBX downloaded by tools/animal_art.py; models and def mapping in assets/animal_art.json
assets.installedTo: FBX files in game/Content/ThirdParty/Animals/ and the imported skeletal meshes, skeletons and animations in game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Animals/ (neither in Git)
assets.usedFor: animal actors for the D5 animals (docs/design/animals.md), drawn by U15

assets.name: Clothes art (Poly Haven hat + garments made from Kellan's clothes)
assets.source: Poly Haven Fishermans Hat (https://polyhaven.com/a/fishermans_hat), 1k glTF downloaded by tools/clothes_art.py; garments are copies of the PawnLooks hoodie and cargo trousers; tuque and helmet made in code. Listed in assets/clothes_art.json
assets.licence: CC0 (hat); the rest derived from Epic sample content, usable in Unreal Engine projects, or our own
assets.usedFor: worn meshes (visual.worn) of the D6 and F2 apparel defs, per layer (docs/design/looks.md)
assets.reinstall: python tools/clothes_art.py, run the PawnLooks commandlet, then "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" C:\Dev\Rim3D\game\Rim3D.uproject -run=ClothesArt -unattended -nosplash -nullrhi
